queries: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_avg_remaining_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(m.mean_avg_remaining_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_avg_remaining_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: CPU–GPU usage gap means CPU usage minus GPU usage for each record; records missing either value are excluded from that average.
If the mean of group averages is zero, the ratio is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Usage gap means the absolute difference between CPU and GPU usage.
